speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To begin our assessment, could you describe the specific nature of your gait disturbance and when you first noticed the ataxia? Also, do you experience any muscle weakness or sensory changes in your limbs?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds like significant cerebellar dysfunction. Do you have a history of head trauma, stroke, or any recent infections? Also, have you noticed any changes in your handwriting or speech patterns?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

Given your history of Crohn's disease and natalizumab use, along with right-sided ataxia, I need to confirm this before proceeding. REQUEST IMAGES: Brain_MRI_with_contrast.
